_note: Template only — entry and integrity are injected at build/install time. The sovereign identity provider: the host's get_identity resolves this plugin via the SPI (providesApi identity:v1) and dispatches identity:whoami to it. It answers with the citizen's sovereign identity (the DID of the PUBLIC key); the private key never leaves the sandbox.
name: Sovereign Identity

whoami.doc: Report the current sovereign identity: its type, storage tier, and identifier (the DID form of the managed PUBLIC key). The private key never leaves the WASM sandbox. Advisory only — a caller must not gate a capability on this.
